query: How can I log in to SIAS using the Student option at BukSU?
answer: To log in to SIAS, open https://sias.buksu.edu.ph/sias/. Click Student if you are a student. Choose the correct role if you are an instructor or another user type. Type your Student ID and password, then click Login.
